label: Blind sample burn 009: MTBS Nimiuktuk River fire, AK, 2020-06-04

verdict.headline: Real change
verdict.statement: Burn ratio (NBR) fell by 0.23 relative to the control trajectory in the 6 months after 4 Jun 2020 (90% interval −0.44 to −0.04). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 0 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.02). Counted by gap size instead, 0 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.02).

evidence.sentence: Optical shows the change (burn ratio (NBR) fell by 0.23); radar has too few observations to weigh in.
